images.description: Admin login/hero abstract dark tech background with orange accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme for both Admin and Restaurant apps. Use zinc-950 as the main background and zinc-900 for surfaces. Accent color MUST be orange-500 (ProDelivery brand color).

Admin Dashboard: Build a responsive interface. Laptop/Desktop layout is paramount, but it MUST be usable on mobile. Use an auto-collapsing sidebar or horizontal tabs for (Comenzi, Program, Livratori, Restaurante). Ensure data tables have horizontal scrolling wrappers (`overflow-x-auto`) to prevent viewport breaking.

Modals & Drawers: For mobile screens, complex forms (like assigning a driver) should open in a bottom sheet/drawer instead of a cramped center modal. On laptop, center modals are fine but must have max-height and internal scrolling.

Restaurant App (KDS): Implement a Kanban/bento grid for the kitchen queue (`kds_order_card`). Display real-time preparation timers using JetBrains Mono. Emphasize visual states: 'New' (Orange accent), 'Preparing' (Blue accent), 'Ready' (Emerald accent), 'Late/Urgent' (Red pulse).
Include a prominent 'Operational Status' toggle in the Restaurant App header (e.g., Accepting Orders vs Paused) with clear visual feedback.
Typography: Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain an industrial/tech precision vibe.
Testing: Add `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (tabs, buttons, order cards, toggles).
Components: Use lucide-react icons. Avoid vanilla HTML inputs, heavily customize shadcn components (dark background, orange focus rings) so they do not look generic.
